title: Save Ring
description: A download control for Abbey Road. Press Download and the pill folds into a progress ring while the colour sweeps round the grey cover like a clock hand, song by song. Tap the ring to stop and the sweep unwinds; tap again mid-unwind and it carries on from there. Remove it and the colour drains back out.
intent: A music-app save control finished to the edge and interruptible both ways, with one flourish: the cover itself is the progress ring, colour sweeping in as the album lands on the device.
